notes.title: The Crush House Update 1.3 Changelog
notes.content:
Happy Thursday, Crushers! 
The Crush House Update 1.3 is now live, with some tweaks and fixes aimed to make your show even better.

[h1]TCH Update 1.3 Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could access the locked difficulty settings earlier than intended
[*] Updated how some of the tasks appear in Jae's menu
[*] Resolved an issue where the time would skip forward
[*] Added in an additional way to delete existing saves
[*] Restarting on a Monday will now allow for players to recast for the season
[*] Increased some of the font sizes for Steam Deck
[*] [REDACTED] will occasionally [REDACTED] the lighthouse
[*] The fish will occasionally look [REDACTED]
[/list]

notes.title: The Crush House Update 1.2 Changelog
notes.content:
Happy Monday Crushers!
Ready to kick off Patch One? We sure hope you are.

[b]Chorby Mischief:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the select button wouldn't appear with particular controller configs in the casting menu
[*] Updated some incorrect character icons in UI pop-ups
[*] Fixed an issue where Milo becoming friends by the Grill, would fail to clear his task objective
[*] Fixed an issue where Jae would be sent straight to bed after receiving a walkie-talkie call from the [REDACTED BY THE NETWORK] under specific circumstances
[*] The casts magical ability to cook in the garden in a floating pot has sadly been taken back by Chorby.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cast would go to the gym together, but one of them would then go to the garden instead.
[*] Fixed an issue where Jae wouldn't update her PDA with how many cast tasks she'd completed for the [REDACTED BY THE NETWORK]
[*] Jae has figured out how to escape the Cardboard Box Prison on the production floor and will no longer get stuck
[*] Fixed Charlie's swimsuit from neon green back to her preferred colour
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a small problem with the Foodies audience
[*] Increased the amount of time relationship changes persist. so they can be filmed
[*] Consolidated the ads formatting to prevent some ad related errors
[*] Improved navigation on the Ratings and in Jae's PDA
[/list]
[b]Something new?![/b]
[list]
[*] Added in some new audio to the tutorial and rainy moments
[/list]

We’ll see you next season!

notes.title: Make the wildest reality TV show in The Crush House - Available now!
notes.content:
[h3][b]FROM:[/b] The Crush House Production Team

[b]TO:[/b] Jae Jimenez Jung

[b]SUBJECT:[/b] Offer of employment[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/05b8f53ed9066e92eeff1896c4ff42f28caf875b.png[/img]


[h3]Jae,[/h3]

We are delighted to offer you the role of PRODUCER on THE CRUSH HOUSE, the hottest reality show on television. Congratulations and welcome aboard.

We are eagerly awaiting your arrival at our beautiful Malibu mansion. But until then, here's an important reminder of what your job will entail -- and what your responsibilities will be once you get behind your camcorder.

There's a reason THE CRUSH HOUSE is the most beloved and successful reality series in history.

Whatever the viewer wants, the viewer gets.

Learn your audience. Study their tastes, their quirks, their thirsts. Then make sure they’re being met, no matter what. Don't judge them, don't question them, just point your camera at whatever makes them happy.

If viewers tune out and ratings fall, it won't just be the end of your career. THE CRUSH HOUSE will be cancelled and taken off the air -- permanently. 

With this in mind, we're sure you understand the importance of your new role as both camera operator and producer. Everything is riding on you. 

But don't worry: you can handle it. 

You were selected for a reason, and we are looking forward to seeing record-breaking network ratings on the next season of THE CRUSH HOUSE.

[h3]Welcome to the team.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/e336ac191d069c07c447c44fb9564a40002107cd.png[/img]

notes.title: The Crush House Demo.. Now Available For EVEN LONGER!
notes.content:
Good morning, Producer!
Since you performed so well during Steam Next Fest and managed to keep the show on air, the Network has decided to give you a bonus:
[h2]The Crush House demo is now available on Steam for EVEN LONGER![/h2]
Until further notice, you still have a job

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/f7f5504439fa7523fae24e92085027ae91c529c8.png[/img]

Each run is different in our Incredibly Realistic Reality TV Simulator. How will the cast interact with each other this time? Will they have the same love/hate relationship? Can they make it to the season finale?  Hop in the demo & find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/bf077bd17bdcf5f0da25b613d4db66f17c8f94df.png[/img]
[h2]A WORD FROM THE DEVELOPERS AT NERIAL[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/baa7a14dc851c2cfd52795b36b6f7fc38cf67e4f.png[/img]

Hi Crushers! We’ve been keeping an eye on the feedback, and here are some frequently asked questions:
- [b]Localization[/b]: Localization will be available upon full launch in 8 additional languages, including French, Spanish, Chinese and more!
- [b]Steam Deck[/b]: We're hoping to get the game verified on Steam Deck for launch. We know about issues playing the Demo on Deck and we are working on them for the full release!
- [b]RAM accumulation + crashes[/b]: we know about these issues (it seems that the game likes to crash on Wednesdays) and are polishing fixes right now.

If you have any questions, feedback or concerns, please let us know!

[url=https://bit.ly/m/TheCrushHouse][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/0e8c97a3444dc8951be906d85429bfaaebd00aa3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Crush House Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Crushers! Thanks for playing The Crush House demo. We’re keeping a close eye on your feedback and suggestions and are doing our best implementing what we can.

[h2]THE CRUSH HOUSE DEMO UPDATE[/h2]
+ Game overs due to death or cancellation now go to the game over screen instead of the demo end screen, allowing the player to retry the failed day or return to the title screen.
+ Added a Vsync toggle to the settings menu, which defaults to “On” to reduce screen tearing.
+ Fixed some settings changes not persisting between sessions.

Thank you for playing the demo, we hope you’re enjoying the reality TV chaos! Don’t forget: even with only 4 cast members, each run will be different!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/2ff7106d524222c5e56f82cf1edecf18d0365783.gif[/img]

notes.title: THE CRUSH HOUSE DEMO & RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
[h2]Rise and shine, Jae! [/h2]
The Network demands a new season of The Crush House, and you’ve been chosen as the lucky Producer behind it all. The Malibu mansion has opened its doors - [b]The Crush House demo is live![/b]
Film the first season, prove yourself to the Network, and don’t get your show cancelled.

[h3]Thirsting for more? The full game releases on August 9th![/h3]
[previewyoutube=Z30Scg9u1u4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/bf077bd17bdcf5f0da25b613d4db66f17c8f94df.png[/img]
[h2]A WORD FROM THE DEVELOPERS [/h2]
[i]Hey Crushers!

We know we’ve made a game that’s quite wacky, a bit experimental, and certainly risqué. For the next two months, we’ll be hard at work fixing up bugs, balancing, polishing, and adding (crush) juice. But we wanted to get the game in your hands as soon as we could, so we’re thrilled to put out this demo!

Note that as the game is not finished, we are actively fixing various issues that you may encounter while you play. So please let us know what you think! Everything you tell us will be helpful as we get the game ready for the launch on August 9th![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/baa7a14dc851c2cfd52795b36b6f7fc38cf67e4f.png[/img]

[h3]What is The Crush House?[/h3]
The Crush House is a [b]Thirst-Person Shooter[/b] where you play as producer Jae, filming 1999’s hottest reality TV show. Equipped with a camcorder, it’s your job to film their drama, and quench the drama-thirsty audiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/e336ac191d069c07c447c44fb9564a40002107cd.png[/img]

[h3]Picking The Cast[/h3]
While there will be 12 potential cast members in the full game, the demo features Charlie, Emile, Alex and Priscilla. Film their love stories, their conflicts, their lives. Just remember: never, ever, ever, speak to them. [b]EVER.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/c6dd0ee7f820fff3cf74c1939b54aa07ea5f522f.png[/img]

[h3]Quenching The Thirsts[/h3]
Attracting viewers is the easy part - then you need to keep them entertained. Each [b][i]audience[/i][/b] group has distinct [i][b]thirsts[/b][/i], Whether it's the Wine Moms, Fish Freaks, Film Students or Butt Guys, they each have an unwavering interest in a certain subject. If you don’t quench them, your show will be CANCELLED.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/651b8410aa96db64380eee95c9b55001be27180c.gif[/img]

[h3]$$$ and Props[/h3]
There’s nothing wrong with selling out for some extra cash. Earn money by playing ads whenever you’re not filming, then spend it on props to upgrade the house. The radical new gear will unlock new dialogue options, help quench thirsts and might even contribute to certain secret objectives. This message is brought to you by [i]Dogmilk[/i]™.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/7b54337a57b836b6e3c9e9ed550ce1958857c8bd.gif[/img]

[h3]Uncover The Secret…[/h3]
But there's more to the house than it's glossy exterior. Will you do your job a good corporate drone or break some rules to test their limits? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/2ff7106d524222c5e56f82cf1edecf18d0365783.gif[/img]

[url=https://bit.ly/m/TheCrushHouse][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962207/0e8c97a3444dc8951be906d85429bfaaebd00aa3.png[/img]
[h3]Let's Crush![/h3][/url]
